description: Scroll: with ref/selector, centre that element into view; otherwise dispatch a wheel delta (dx/dy). Options: timeoutMs. Returns: { ok, session_id, target } (into-view) or { ok, session_id, dx, dy } (wheel). Errors: SELECTOR_NO_MATCH / REF_NOT_FOUND (no element matched the selector; carries similar_refs), NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (ref+selector both).

dx.description: Horizontal wheel delta in CSS px (used when no ref/selector).

dy.description: Vertical wheel delta in CSS px (used when no ref/selector).

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Actionability budget in ms (default 5000, clamped to 30000).

name: electron_scroll
title: Scroll the page or an element into view
